body.statement: For every \(R\in\mathcal R_0(n,K)\), \(W_R(C_+)=W_R(C_-)=1\) if \(R=mE_{LL}+mE_{00}\), and \(W_R(C_+)=W_R(C_-)=0\) otherwise.
body.justification: Endpoint saturation is the only universal nonbinary tie and supplies the exact probability bound behind the non-orbit corner test.
body.gap: The compatible-table literature in \cite{RigdonHudgens2015} enumerates nuisance schedules for inference but does not isolate this schedule-universal endpoint identity.
body.consumer: It yields an analytic weak-null p-value with granularity \(\binom{2m}{m}^{-1}\), avoiding nuisance enumeration for this rare event.
